best_idea: Run each match on one fixed-rate loop that takes one bounded batch of inputs per tick and counts join and idle timeouts in ticks, so the timing lives in the tick counter, not in per-player timers.
decision_why: Keep the fixed-rate loop, the single bounded input drain per tick, and tick-counted join and idle limits; change the overflow policy, because the donor closes the whole match when its call queue fills and Frankendom must not end a fight on an input burst.
acceptance: A server test pushes three times the input cap in one tick and asserts the fight keeps ticking, the drop count equals the overflow, and kept inputs apply in arrival order on the next tick; a second test leaves a join unconfirmed and asserts it expires at join tick plus 15 times the rate, swept on the 30-second tick boundary.
